title: Difference quotients of a weak solution solve the translated weak system on B_{2R}
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, L := L(R^n, R^l), U an open subset of R^n, a : R^n -> (continuous bilinear forms on L), Phi : R^n -> (continuous linear forms on L), v : R^n -> R^l, xb, e in R^n and R, d real with R > 0, closedBall(xb, 4R) ⊆ U, |e| <= 1, d ≠ 0 and |d| < R. Assume x ↦ a(x)[P][Q] (all P, Q) and x ↦ Phi(x)[P] (all P) are continuous on U, v is C^1 on U, and the integral over U of a(x)[Dv(x)][Dzeta(x)] equals the integral over U of Phi(x)[Dzeta(x)] for every C^1 compactly supported zeta : R^n -> R^l with tsupport zeta ⊆ U. Then there is Psi : R^n -> (continuous linear forms on L) with Psi(x)[P] = d^{-1}(Phi(x + de)[P] - Phi(x)[P]) - d^{-1}(a(x + de)[Dv(x + de)][P] - a(x)[Dv(x + de)][P]) for all x, P, such that, with w(z) := d^{-1}(v(z + de) - v(z)) and B := B_{2R}(xb) (open ball), the integral over B of a(x)[Dw(x)][Dzeta(x)] equals the integral over B of Psi(x)[Dzeta(x)] for every C^1 compactly supported zeta with tsupport zeta ⊆ B.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (a : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (Φ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (xb e : Rn n) (R d : ℝ), IsOpen U → 0 < R → closedBall xb (4 * R) ⊆ U → ‖e‖ ≤ 1 → d ≠ 0 → |d| < R → (∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ContinuousOn (fun x => a x P Q) U) → (∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ContinuousOn (fun x => Φ x P) U) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 v U → (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x in U, a x (fderiv ℝ v x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = ∫ x in U, Φ x (fderiv ℝ ζ x)) → ∃ Ψ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ, (∀ (x : Rn n) (P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ), Ψ x P = d⁻¹ * (Φ (x + d • e) P - Φ x P) - d⁻¹ * (a (x + d • e) (fderiv ℝ v (x + d • e)) P - a x (fderiv ℝ v (x + d • e)) P)) ∧ ∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball xb (2 * R) → ∫ x in ball xb (2 * R), a x (fderiv ℝ (fun z => d⁻¹ • (v (z + d • e) - v z)) x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = ∫ x in ball xb (2 * R), Ψ x (fderiv ℝ ζ x)
